title: Build Your First Network — Turn the Experiment into a Reproducible Artifact
key_insight: Give each run a versioned configuration and record dataset fingerprint, source revision, dependency versions, metrics, and artifacts. Reproducibility is a property of the whole route, not one random seed.
body:
## Turn the Experiment into a Reproducible Artifact

A good result cannot be trusted if nobody can identify the data, code, settings, or environment that produced it.

Give each run a versioned configuration and record dataset fingerprint, source revision, dependency versions, metrics, and artifacts. Reproducibility is a property of the whole route, not one random seed.

Before promotion, compare against a simple baseline and inspect errors by group. A deeper model earns its cost only when the gain is stable, useful, and deployable.
common_mistakes: A model learns merely because its script exits successfully.
Only the final accuracy number is needed to reproduce a run.
Validation rows should be used for every weight update.
mini_exercise: Sketch the situation in “Turn the Experiment into a Reproducible Artifact” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: This capstone proves the learner can connect Phase 5’s parts into a working training system.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “Turn the Experiment into a Reproducible Artifact” situation, explain Build Your First Network without assuming the listener knows deep learning.
